paragraphs.text: The Raynor Glacier was one of the great glaciers in the north of Terisiare , during the Ice Age on Dominaria .

Around 2434 AR , the glacier had already covered the northern quadrant of the kingdom of Storgard and was advancing multiple feet a year. It eventually grew over the rest of the kingdom and destroyed its castle. Later, Soldev would be founded on its ruins.

A cavern inside the glacier was known as the Labyrinth of Raynor . It was here that Tevash Szat ’s Phyrexian priest amassed black mana , and where Jaeuhl Carthalion found the Amulet of Quoz at the end of the Ice Age.
